hero.intro: I build fast, accessible web apps and Shopify storefronts — from retail analytics dashboards to e-commerce platforms. Currently taking on new freelance projects.

statements.desc: Core Web Vitals treated as a requirement, not an afterthought.
Keyboard navigation, screen readers, and contrast — checked, not bolted on after.
Scraping, bots, and repetitive work handled — so the important decisions get the attention.

manifesto.closing: 7 years across companies, agencies, and products — retail analytics platforms to e-commerce storefronts. One person across frontend, Shopify, scraping, bots, performance, and accessibility. Nothing lost between departments that don't exist.
